_comment: Follow-up sequences. Nobody is EVER enrolled by a trigger — David enrols a person by hand from the dashboard. That is the whole point: GHL's trigger-based workflows fired at the wrong people and made the business look unprofessional. Steps fire relative to the enrolment date. A 'call' step never dials anyone; it puts a task in Today.

cadences.name: Seller follow-up
cadences.for: Someone who asked what their land is worth and went quiet

steps.body: Hi {{first}} — David with Alot of Land. Just making sure you got my note about your property. Happy to talk whenever suits you.

steps.note: First call attempt. If no answer, leave a voicemail saying you'll follow up by text.

steps.subject: Your land — a couple of quick questions
steps.body:
Hi {{first}},

I wanted to follow up on your property. To put a real number together I usually need three things: roughly how many acres, the county, and whether there's road frontage.

Reply with those and I'll come back with a number and how I got to it.

David
Hi {{first}} — still interested in a number on your land? No pressure either way, just don't want to leave you hanging.

steps.note: Second call attempt. If still nothing, mark the deal lost or park it.

steps.subject: Closing the file on your land
steps.body:
Hi {{first}},

I haven't heard back so I'll close this out — no hard feelings. If anything changes, my number is in this thread and I'll pick up.

David

cadences.name: Buyer follow-up
cadences.for: Someone who enquired on a lot and went quiet

steps.body: Hi {{first}} — David with Alot of Land. Any questions on the lot you were looking at? Happy to walk it with you.

steps.subject: Want to walk the property?
steps.body:
Hi {{first}},

Easiest way to know if a piece of land is right is to stand on it. I can meet you out there, or send you the soil map and survey if you'd rather look first.

Which would you prefer?

David

steps.note: Call. Ask what's holding them up — usually access, septic or financing.

steps.body: Hi {{first}} — still looking? If that lot isn't the one, tell me what you're after and I'll keep an eye out.

steps.subject: Anything else you'd like me to look for?
steps.body:
Hi {{first}},

I'll stop chasing this particular lot. If you tell me the acreage, county and budget you're after, I'll let you know when something matches.

David

cadences.name: Missed showing
cadences.for: Booked a showing and did not turn up

steps.body: Hi {{first}} — sorry we missed each other today. Want to pick another time?

steps.note: Call. Something usually came up — worth one human attempt before giving up.

steps.subject: Still want to see the property?
steps.body:
Hi {{first}},

Happy to find another time, or send photos and the survey if it's easier.

David
